contexts.text: To go out from the faces of Jehovah () = to be separated from the good of the faith of love.
It went out in going out and returning () ( = their state which is such. AC 867.)
Their end is...
They shall go out with great substance () = deliverance... To go out = to be delivered.
When the sons of Israel went out from Egypt, there was represented... AC 2438:2.
Lot went out to them to the door () = that he prudently applied himself.

It is said of the Holy Spirit that it is sent, that is, that it goes out from the Divine of the Lord; as in... The Spirit of Truth which goeth out from the Father... Hence the prophets were called the sent, because the words which they spoke went out from the Holy of the Spirit of the Lord. And as all Divine truth goes out from Divine good, the term sent is properly predicated of Divine truth. Hence it is evident what to go out is; namely, that he who goes out, or that which goes out, is his from whom it goes out.
Arise, go out from this place () = that they should not remain in a state of evil... To go out = to recede, or not to remain.
When birth from the mother is treated of, it is said to go out from the womb, but when from the father, to be separated from the bowels.
The first went out red ()... To go out = to be born.

In going out Jacob had scarcely gone out from the faces... () = progression and change of state; (for) going out to go out from the faces = when those things ceased which were represented by Jacob, thus when the state was changed.
Jacob went out from Beersheba () = life more remote from Divine doctrinal things. To go = to live.
He went out from the Father = that the Divine Itself assumed the Human.
Go out from this land () = separation from this good.
To go out from Seir. Explained.
Hamor- went out... to Jacob.
To go out first () = priority and superiority.
Joseph went out upon the land of Egypt () = when both Naturals were His. To go out, here = to flow in.

Joseph went out from before Pharaoh () = when the Natural in general was his. To go out = to be his... For to go out, or proceed, in the spiritual sense, is to present one's self before another in a form accommodated to him, thus as the same in another form. Illustrated.

It is said of truth that it goes out or proceeds from good, when truth is the form of good... It may also be said of the understanding that it goes out or proceeds from the will, when it is the will formed... In like manner it may be said of thought... to go out or proceed, when it becomes speech, and of will when it becomes action... Still, it is the thought which so goes out or proceeds... It may also be said of the external man that it goes out or proceeds from the internal man, yea, substantially, because the external man is nothing but the internal so formed as to act suitably in the world...

From these examples it may be evident that... when to go out, or to proceed, is predicated of the Lord, it = the Divine formed as a Man, thus accommodated to the perception of believers; still, both are one.
Their heart went out () = fear... because the heart, in fear, palpitates.
(Joseph) went out () = by removal. Explained.
One went out from me () = the apparent departure of internal good.
They can no more go out (from Hell).
He goeth out to meet thee () = reception; (for) to go out to meet, here, = to be presented ready for receiving...
To go out () = a sending forth.
To go out from Pharaoh () = when falsities did not so much infest.
Moses and Aaron went out from before Pharaoh () = separation from those who reasoned from mere falsities. To go out = to be separated. AC 7650.
I will go out into the midst of Egypt () = the presence then of the Divine everywhere.
Go out thou and all the people who are in thy feet () = supplication that they may depart from those who are in truth...
And after I will so go out () = that truth Divine will depart.
He went out from with Pharaoh in wrath of anger () = the tearing away of the presence of truth Divine from those who are to be damned. Explained.
By the departure from Egypt is signified separation from those who infested.
Not to go out () = to remain permanently.
To go out from the land of Egypt () = to be taken out and delivered from infestations.
To go out = to be delivered; for by the going out of the sons of Israel is signified the deliverance of those who are of the Spiritual Church. AC 8065. AC 8153. AC 8401. AC 9292. AC 10659.
They went out to the wilderness of Shur () = the state of temptation into which they were afterwards brought. To go out = to be brought.
To go out to meet () = application. Explained.
To make the people go out to meet God () = the power to prepare them to receive the Divine.
To go out () = the state after combat. AC 8980. AC 8984. AC 8987. AC 8994.
To go out () = estrangement.
To go out (), when predicated of the formation of good from truths, = from the internal man into the external.
The end of the year () = the the works.
The outlet of the waters () = the Natural of man which receives the Knowledges of truth and good.
Under Enter, see this reference.
To Know the going out and the coming in = to know all the thoughts and acts of the life.
To keep the going out and the coming in () = the whole of the life according to the state of good and truth.
To go in and go out () = to be led by the Lord as to every state of life, thus to think and will good from freedom... (Further illustrated.)
The truths of the Word in the sense of the letter are in like manner signified by the outlet of the waters.
To go out and speak () = communication.
To enter and to go out = communication. References.
To go out, and to proceed = nothing but to enlighten and teach by presence, which is according to the reception of the Lord.
Before this there is no outlet for concupiscences, and if there is no outlet they remain within... DP 113:end. See DP 281:3.
To go out from the mouth of the Lord () = from the Word.
This is meant by... I went out from the Father...
The egress out of a forest.
To go out is predicated of truth. AE 386:21. The outlet of the waters () = abundance; the natural man is the outlet.
To go out and fight = to execute judgment. AE 405:44.
Be glad, Zebulon, in thy going out () = that they have delight in all genuine truths and goods: the going out, or outlet = all things, because it = the ultimate, the effect, and the conclusion.
They shall hear the voice of the Son of Man, and shall go out. Explained.
To go out and to enter = the states of life from beginning to end.
To go out = to recede, namely, from that doctrine; and thus to be delivered from spiritual captivity.
The outlet = their ultimates, such as are the truths of the sense of the letter.
Go out from her. My people () = that they should leave them, and not communicate with them.
God 8. 1. In all things which have gone out and which go out from Him...
